description: The I.K.S. Gre’thor is the pinnacle of House Sov engineering, and a symbol of their rejection of rigid Klingon ideals of honor. Built to pack a punch that would make even Imperial fleets pause, this ship is nonetheless swift and nimble in battle. With advanced shielding and disruptor cannons that draw on interdimensional energies, the I.K.S. Gre’thor’s name is a promise - this hellion will wreak havoc on anyone who stands against it.

ship_ability.title: Apex Aegis
ship_ability.description: Increases Apex Barrier by +{value} at the start of combat versus players (does not apply to Stations).
